films.descriptionZh: 上世纪六十年代的小说家周在写作与情感之间游走，借虚构与现实交织出丰腴的忧郁。

films.canonicalTitle: A Day in the Country + People on Sunday
films.displayTitle: A Day in the Country + People on Sunday
films.descriptionZh: 两部轻盈诗意的户外短长片联映，捕捉稍纵即逝的假日。
法国诗人阿尔图尔·兰波的非凡人生，充满诗性的震撼与顽皮。
films.descriptionEn: The improbably eventful life of French poet Arthur Rimbaud unfolds with the same shock and playfulness found in his poetry, tracing the moods and episodes that made his legend.

films.descriptionZh: 孤獨白領保羅在深夜紐約展開一連串荒誕又危險的夜間遭遇。
愛麗絲跌入兔子洞，展開充滿奇幻與古怪冒險的仙境旅程。
films.descriptionEn: On a golden afternoon, curious Alice tumbles into a burrow and enters the merry, madcap world of Wonderland, where whimsical escapades unfold.

films.descriptionZh: 一名美军上尉奉命深入越战腹地执行秘密任务，航程逐渐化为疯狂之旅。
冷战柏林中，MI6特工劳伦必须靠狡诈与武力完成一项危险潜伏任务。
films.descriptionEn: An elite MI6 assassin is sent on a covert mission into Cold War Berlin, where she must use spycraft, sensuality, and savagery to recover a priceless dossier while fighting deadly killers amid a web of double-crosses.

films.descriptionZh: 學者進城採集俚語，遇上風騷夜歌女，展開機智又詼諧的語言冒險。
芭比在理想的芭比樂園遭遇存在危機，並引出肯的存在焦慮。
films.descriptionEn: In a perfect, manufactured world, beings live flawless lives—until existential crises (and a Ken) reveal cracks beneath the surface of Barbie Land.

films.descriptionZh: 爱幻想的年轻职员在谎言与逃离小城的机会之间摇摆。
複雜未來城中，獵人德卡德受命追緝幾名逃回地球的複製人。
哥譚式華麗改編，德古拉的欲望與復仇在豪華製作中被強烈呈現。

films.displayTitle: Castration Movie Chapter iii. Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage + Q&A | Musclefest

films.descriptionZh: 八位纽约芭蕾学生在竞争、欲望与艺术理想之间成长。
两个失恋警察、菠萝罐头与加州梦交织的香港情书。
一位准新郎在安纳西湖区对一位少女的膝盖产生近乎虔诚的痴迷。
films.descriptionEn: In the Lake Annecy environs, a cultured soon‑to‑be‑wed diplomat becomes obsessively fixated on an acquaintance’s daughter’s knee, a fetish that unfolds into an almost religious personal quest within Rohmer’s moral tale.

films.canonicalTitle: Classical Period + All the World’s Memory
films.displayTitle: Classical Period + All the World’s Memory
films.descriptionZh: 一群年轻智者在达恩特研讨与语言练习间展开学术辩论；短片则跟随一本名为《火星》的新书穿越法国国家图书馆的藏书与阅览室。
洛杉矶出租车司机被职业杀手挟持，在一夜之间驶入致命任务。
生物教授在生物科技大会爆发变异病毒，困在会场与幸存者奋战。
一位因凶杀案受创的犯罪心理学家与一名实地探案女警联手追踪复制历来连环杀人案手法的新凶手。
一本失踪的藏书、亡学者的遗稿和一条被诅咒的古符将怀疑的调查逐步转为生死竞逐。
路易丝企图骗取婆婆的遗产，却让家族秘事逐渐演变为一连串谋杀。
一个迷恋流行歌手的少女在遭到轻视后走向极端，成为令人不安的心理慢燃惊悚。
一名男孩與迷失外星人在家庭與冒險中建立深厚友誼，發出想回家的呼喚。
一名自信商人謀殺情人丈夫，引發一連串不幸事件。
films.descriptionEn: A self‑assured businessman murders his employer—the husband of his mistress—which unintentionally sets off an ill‑fated chain of events.

films.descriptionZh: 路易斯安那一户富裕家庭的女儿目睹父亲不忠，童年纯真随之消逝。
王家卫拍夜香港：杀手、失恋者与擦肩而过的欲望。
失眠男子與肥皂推銷員創立地下鬥毆社，演變成失控的暴力與反叛運動。
非傳統傳記以碎片化手法探究卡夫卡的內心世界與創作淵源。
和平之地遭机械军团袭击，人民被石化，众人寻因。
films.descriptionEn: In a distant world, a peace‑loving civilization faces a merciless army of automata that turns its people to stone; a council of matriarchs sends brave seekers to discover the source of the Men of Metal and confront their destiny.

films.descriptionZh: 台北老戏院最后一场放映，各色观众与记忆交织。
四位三十多歲的老友因離婚消息重整人生，展開長時間的自我與友情檢視。
王家卫以布宜诺斯艾利斯为背景拍一段反复破裂的爱情。
一位執著偵探與一名聰明竊賊因一宗高風險證券劫案交織命運。
films.descriptionEn: An obsessive detective and a brilliant thief find their fates intertwined in the aftermath of a high-stakes securities heist, setting up a taut psychological drama between cat and mouse.

films.descriptionZh: 神秘迷霧籠罩未來都會，一名少女踏上尋父之旅，遭遇致命而難解的存在。
films.descriptionEn: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis and releases a deadly, elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father; her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey.

films.canonicalTitle: How to Divorce During the War
films.displayTitle: How to Divorce During the War
films.descriptionZh: 高飞女高管玛丽娅在俄军入侵前一天提出离婚，夫妻在难民与中年危机中分离。
films.descriptionEn: High-flying executive Marija tells her husband she wants a divorce just one day before a sudden invasion upends everything, forcing their private choice to collide with a national emergency and its chaotic fallout.

films.descriptionZh: 年輕的艾略特成為藝術家兼挑釁者的性靈感與下屬，慾望與權力關係逐漸改變他的生活。
films.descriptionEn: Elliot, an aimless twenty-something, becomes the sexual muse and subordinate to provocative artist Erika Tracy; their charged relationship forces him to confront desire, boundaries, and his existing relationships as power dynamics escalate.

films.descriptionZh: 年轻的艾略特成为艺术家埃丽卡的性缪斯，卷入性、痴迷与谋杀的漩涡。
films.descriptionEn: A fresh-faced young man is hired by provocative artist Erika Tracy to be her sexual muse, only to be drawn into a darker journey of obsession, power, betrayal, and murder as their relationship intensifies.

films.descriptionZh: 一名巴黎女性因腿傷陷入對自我身體的執著，最終導致自我毀滅式的沉迷。

films.canonicalTitle: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade on 70mm
films.displayTitle: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade on 70mm
films.descriptionZh: 印第安纳·琼斯为寻失踪的学者之父与一本手写日记，展开跨越图书馆与古墓的冒险追索。
倒叙结构的极端复仇悲剧；内容强烈，谨慎选择。
一群应届毕业生深夜驱车外出，原想享受最后相聚，却意外驶入另一条路改变行程。
一群应届毕业生深夜驾车误入一条无尽的两车道地狱，面对未知的恐怖与宇宙力量。
两个高中闺蜜的关系因其中一人变成吞食男孩肉体的魅魔而破裂，校园惊悚与戏谑并存。

films.canonicalTitle: Jonah Who Will Be 25 in the Year 2000
films.displayTitle: Jonah Who Will Be 25 in the Year 2000
films.descriptionZh: 一群日内瓦年轻人在乡间退隐，围绕理想与政治信念展开日常与辩论。
films.descriptionEn: A group of eight nonconformist Genevans retreat to the countryside to imagine a world beyond consumerism; their conversations and relationships stage a political yet intimate exploration of post‑May 1968 ideals.

films.descriptionZh: 三位小镇女乐手意外签约成名，却发现厂牌另有阴谋操控青春文化。
films.descriptionEn: Three small‑town musicians suddenly score a major record deal and rocket to global fame, only to uncover that their rise is part of a sinister plot by their label’s powerful CEO to manipulate the youth.

films.descriptionZh: 布列松用一张假钞追踪偶然如何一路酿成悲剧。
巴黎郊区三位青年在骚乱后的一天，怒火不断逼近爆点。
安东尼奥尼凝视一段婚姻在米兰上流社交中悄然瓦解。
费城公寓管理员在泳池发现神秘女子后，平凡生活被奇幻童话卷入。
年长诗人被年轻崇拜者重新发现，虚荣与旧梦随之苏醒。
勞倫斯在沙漠中聯合阿拉伯部落，掀起對奧斯曼帝國的戰爭與身世探索。
films.descriptionEn: A sweeping biography traces an enigmatic desert-loving Englishman who unites Arab tribes to fight the Ottoman Turks during World War I, presenting a complex portrait of his character and deeds.

films.descriptionZh: 亚马逊劳动工会在争取公司承认与谈判中持续抗争。
films.descriptionEn: Following the Amazon Labor Union’s historic win to unionize a U.S. warehouse, the organization continues to press the company—now refusing to recognize or negotiate a contract—pursuing pressure tactics and affiliation to force bargaining.

films.descriptionZh: 與粉絲同看《Love Island》重聚特輯，由Ariana Madix與Andy Cohen主持，一起揭露別墅後的情感八卦。
films.descriptionEn: Join a drama-filled watch party for the Love Island USA Season 8 Reunion hosted by Ariana Madix and Andy Cohen, where post-villa revelations about which couples stayed together, which split, and the ensuing chaos and commentary unfold.

films.descriptionZh: 荒原中，孤獨的瑪克斯與一群倖存者駕駛戰車逃離暴君追捕。
films.descriptionEn: Haunted by his past, a lone wanderer becomes swept up with survivors fleeing across the Wasteland in a war rig driven by Furiosa as they escape a tyrannical Citadel and face a relentless pursuit.

films.descriptionZh: 美食网红的成功压力唤醒她极力压下的过往。
films.descriptionEn: A plucky dishwasher at a trendy food content company leaps to viral superstardom, enjoying an adoring husband and devoted best friend, even as mounting pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her past.

films.canonicalTitle: Michael Mann's Manhunter: The Final Cut
films.displayTitle: Michael Mann's Manhunter: The Final Cut
films.descriptionZh: FBI 侧写师追捕连环杀手，冷峻色彩与电子乐塑造现代惊悚。
films.descriptionEn: A retired criminal profiler reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track a serial killer, in a tense, genre-defining thriller restored for its 40th anniversary under the filmmaker’s supervision.

films.canonicalTitle: Missing Movies Double Feature: The Kill-Off + My New Gun
films.displayTitle: Missing Movies Double Feature: The Kill-Off + My New Gun
films.descriptionZh: 兩部新澤西黑色電影：一家夜店風波引發謀殺與謊言；郊區婦人因一把槍而陷入荒誕變局。
男友自杀後，她以遺留的手稿與錢試圖改寫人生。
films.descriptionEn: After her boyfriend’s suicide, a young woman finds an unpublished manuscript and a sum of money he left behind and attempts to use them as the means to reinvent her life.

films.descriptionZh: 两位女子在好莱坞展开一段迷离的寻踪旅程。
Gregg Araki 以两段破碎记忆直视创伤与自我认知。
法庭外，法官傑西卡在家庭與職責間掙扎，私下熱愛卡拉OK、是慈愛的配偶與家長。
films.descriptionEn: Jessica Parks is a smart Crown Court judge whose public authority masks a private life—she loves karaoke, supports her family, and confronts a personal crisis that tests her role on the bench.

films.descriptionZh: 為洗清家族罪名，寶藏獵人追尋祕密檔案，歷經拼圖般的冒險與驚險場面。
两位儿时好友在太平洋西北的森林里重聚，静默中流露出中年哀愁和友谊的消逝。
拉斯维加斯的一对恋人在周年纪念日争吵分手，各自踏上一夜浪漫奇遇。
母女躲進家中防暴室，卻在入侵者的貓鼠遊戲中被迫自救。
films.descriptionEn: When three armed robbers invade her home, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in a specially designed panic room, only to find themselves trapped in a deadly cat‑and‑mouse struggle inside the house.

films.descriptionZh: 一段婚姻在西柏林走向疯狂與恐怖的崩解。
年輕新婦嫁入莊園後，始終被亡妻麗貝卡的幽影與家中祕密所困。
一场抢劫幸存者带着赃款回乡，用新得的财富在村中建立起繁荣与谎言，良心与流言随之蚀去。
小偷赴南美叢林與同夥運送硝化甘油，與大自然展開生死角力。
films.descriptionEn: A small‑time crook from Brooklyn joins fellow hard‑luck men in the sweltering South American jungle to haul nitroglycerine, turning a perilous job into a bleak, elemental confrontation between humans and nature.

films.descriptionZh: 賽車手Speed為保家業揭發賽事被財團操控，與家人並肩挑戰陰謀。

films.displayTitle: Stepping Into the Unknown: Films from the Bob Dylan Center

films.descriptionZh: 一碗拉面串起美食、欲望与日本社会的类型喜剧。
films.descriptionEn: Two milk‑truck drivers help the owner of a rundown roadside stall sharpen her ramen skills in a brash, bawdy celebration of food, desire, and the pleasures of the table and boudoir in a raucous “ramen Western.”

films.canonicalTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.displayTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.descriptionZh: 一位年轻导演前往拜访退隐的原片女星，兩人陷入充滿慾望與恐懼的血腥世界，面對重生與自我實現的試煉。
films.descriptionEn: A young director aiming to revive a camp slasher franchise visits the original film’s reclusive star; their encounter pulls both women into a surreal, bloody world of desire, fear, and delirium under threat from the menacing Little Death.

films.descriptionZh: 瘫痪的法医天才从床上指挥调查，年轻巡警在纽约地下寻线索，一本旧书牵出案件真相。
作曲家搬入空宅後發現幽靈痕跡，循自動書寫與古案記錄追查一宗世紀之謀殺。
一名监听专家从受托录下的对话中察觉谋杀阴谋，也陷入日益加深的疑惧。
诺兰把超级英雄片升级为关于秩序与混乱的都市犯罪史诗。
films.descriptionEn: Chicago doubles as a glum Gotham where Bruce Wayne’s alter ego confronts an anarchic Clown Prince of Crime, while Commissioner Gordon stands as the voice of law in a city tipping toward Bedlam amid looming architectural oppression.

films.descriptionZh: 纽约一个势力庞大的黑帮家族，在权力传承与暴力冲突中经历动荡。
影片交错讲述维托·柯里昂的崛起与儿子迈克尔掌权后的家族衰落。
David Bowie 与 Catherine Deneuve 主演的华丽吸血鬼爱情。
一对中年夫妇邀请楼上年轻夫妇聚会，意外发展改变了当晚。
films.descriptionEn: A middle-aged couple invites the younger, livelier pair upstairs for a get-together that unexpectedly upends both relationships, exposing emotional costs and prompting wincing laughs of recognition.

films.descriptionZh: 一场邻里晚餐逐渐揭开两段婚姻的欲望与裂缝。
一位孤独的医生和前任屋主通过湖边旧居交换情书，解开非凡爱情之谜。
films.descriptionEn: A lonely doctor who once occupied an unusual lakeside house begins exchanging love letters with its former resident, a frustrated architect; together they try to unravel the mystery behind their extraordinary, time‑crossing romance.

films.displayTitle: The Matter Propounded: Three Films by David Gatten

films.canonicalTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.displayTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.descriptionZh: 夜晚的京都奇遇记，少女在纵情狂欢中与形形色色人物相遇，展开荒诞一夜。
雾锁庄园中的哥特鬼故事，靠空间与沉默制造寒意。
一名郊区主妇突然离家，独自驾车横越美国寻找生活的另一种可能。
一名美國老兵展開靈性追尋，從巴黎到喜馬拉雅返回故里，發現世事已變。
films.descriptionEn: An American World War I veteran embarks on a spiritual quest that carries him from Paris to Nepal and the Himalayas and back home, where he finds that he—and those around him—have been irrevocably changed.

films.descriptionZh: 黑泽清的新作，以武士时代故事拆解忠诚与囚禁。
修道院出身的家庭教師贏得馮特拉普家的心，帶領他們逃往自由。
films.descriptionEn: A convent-trained governess wins the hearts of the Von Trapp family and, through courage and music, leads them across the Alps in their 1938 flight to freedom.

films.descriptionZh: 阿尔文骑着割草机从爱荷华出发，前往威斯康星与病重兄长团聚。
films.descriptionEn: Leaving his Iowa home and his sister behind, Alvin Straight sets out on an improbable journey by lawnmower to Wisconsin to reunite with his ailing brother, a quietly moving road story focused on family and resolve.

films.descriptionZh: 自由奔放的温蒂在与年长离异的杰克的关系中陷入抉择，旧爱回归让局势复杂化。
films.descriptionEn: Free-spirited Wendy finds herself at a crossroads in her relationship with an older divorced father, forcing both of them to confront change and where they go from here.

films.descriptionZh: 老太太与忠犬追寻被绑架的孙子，意外与三位老牌姊妹结伴冒险。
纽约帮派被诬陷后横穿全城返乡的夜行冒险。

films.canonicalTitle: The Wind that Shakes the Barley - 35MM | 2006 Movies
films.displayTitle: The Wind that Shakes the Barley - 35MM | 2006 Movies
films.descriptionZh: 爱尔兰独立战争中，两兄弟以游击战对抗英军。
films.descriptionEn: Against the backdrop of the Irish War of Independence, two brothers take up a guerrilla campaign against British forces, their bond and loyalties tested by the violence and politics surrounding them.

films.descriptionZh: 马德里电影系学生安赫拉在探索影像暴力时，偶然发现一盘可能是真实暴力录像，研究很快演变为谋杀调查。
一對新戀人帶著走私毒品落跑，暴力與浪漫在逃亡旅程中互相交織。

films.displayTitle: TUCKER: THE MAN AND HIS DREAM

films.descriptionZh: 年轻人回到家乡，在家庭与阶层现实中重新定位自己。
兩兄弟在俄亥俄農村接受法院指定的戒毒方案，各自面對復原與家庭壓力。
films.descriptionEn: Brothers Cody and Jack Parsons navigate court-mandated drug rehabilitation in a rural Ohio community hard hit by the opioid crisis, testing their bond and prospects for recovery.

films.descriptionZh: 希区柯克关于欲望、替身与执念的迷离悬疑经典。
films.descriptionEn: An ex‑cop turned private investigator tails a mysterious woman and becomes entrapped in a whirlpool of obsession, doppelgängers, and escalating supernatural quandaries that lead toward a tragic denouement.

films.descriptionEn: Two young Sydney siblings, having fled into the Outback after their father’s breakdown, meet an Aboriginal teenager on his solitary walkabout who guides them through a harsh yet revealing landscape that slowly reveals Edenic beauty.

films.descriptionZh: 一位佛蒙特主婦懷疑鄰居謀殺，其孤寂生活與超自然現象交織。

films.canonicalTitle: When We Saw Each Other More Often + Q&A
films.displayTitle: When We Saw Each Other More Often + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 在一座未命名的德国城市里，几位年轻人的生活在教室、咖啡馆、酒吧與火车站交错。
关于纽约明星猫头鹰 Flaco 与城市投射的纪录片。
films.descriptionEn: A portrait connected to wildlife rehabilitation that brings educator and rehabilitator Suzanne Highland together with notable avian subject Flaco the Owl, exploring human–wildlife relationships through encounters and care.
